Definition: to slacken (in many applications, literal or figurative)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to sink, relax, sink down, let drop, be disheartened; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to sink down; 1a2) to sink, drop; 1a3) to sink, relax, abate; 1a4) to relax, withdraw; 1b) (Niphal) idle (participle); 1c) (Piel) to let drop; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to let drop, abandon, relax, refrain, forsake; 1d2) to let go; 1d3) to refrain, let alone; 1d4) to be quiet; 1e) (Hithpael) to show oneself slack
